kept.title: Active road resurfacing on Mutual St nearby
kept.detail: The City lists active resurfacing on Mutual St, starting 147 m from this point, running Q2 2025 - Q2 2026. The work includes sidewalk and curb repairs and may close lanes or the whole road. The data does not show which hours the crews work or whether sidewalks are closed during late-night or early-morning walks.

kept.title: Sidewalk clearing after snow is not immediate
kept.detail: The City starts clearing sidewalks once snow reaches 2 cm, and a full clearing cycle typically takes about 12 hours. A walk to a stop before 05:30 or after 23:00 could fall within that window. The data does not show when sidewalks on this route get cleared.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.

kept.title: Laneways are salted only, not plowed
kept.detail: Under the Council-approved service level, public laneways are only salted, within 24 hours after snowfall ends, and are not plowed. Any shortcut through a laneway may still have snow on it.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.

kept.title: Clearing at transit stops focuses on TTC priority stops
kept.detail: The report says the TTC gave the City a list of priority stops and routes so clearing could focus on busy, higher-risk locations. The data does not show whether the stops near this address are on that list.

cites.quote: the TTC provided a list of priority stops and routes, which helped focus clearing efforts on high- traffic and higher-risk locations.
